title: Nobel Prize in Physics goes to Francis Halzen
summary: Francis Halzen, a Belgian physicist, is recognized for pioneering neutrino astronomy through his leadership in building the IceCube Neutrino Observatory at the South Pole, which detected cosmic neutrinos and opened a new window for observing the universe.
problem_solved: Detecting high-energy neutrinos from cosmic sources to understand extreme astrophysical phenomena like supernovae, black holes, and gamma-ray bursts.
why_valuable: Establishes neutrino astronomy as a legitimate field of study and validates decades of work detecting 'ghost particles' from the cosmos, enabling us to observe the universe in ways previously impossible.
